sourceNote: Selective DGT editorial notes for 2 John.

1:1: “Chosen lady” (ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ) may address an individual woman or personify a local church; DGT leaves the expression open.
1:7: The present participle ἐρχόμενον, “coming,” presents Jesus Christ as the one who comes in the flesh. DGT keeps the participial wording rather than resolving the theological nuance for the reader.
1:9: προάγων can mean “going ahead” or “going beyond.” In context, DGT uses “goes beyond” for moving past the teaching of Christ.
